QuestInfo.name: A Gift from Gere
QuestInfo.0: #rProfession Grand Opening Quest\n#k(Available until Jan 31st, 2011)#k\nTo celebrate reaching Lv #r4#k in Smithing, #bGere#k has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Your hard work is being recognized. Congratulations!
QuestInfo.2: Master #bGere#k will have another gift for you once you reach Lv. #r10#k Smithing. Keep up the good work!

0.0: #h0#... A Lv. 4 Blacksmith, eh? I never thought I'd see the day. Very well, I suppose you deserve some small amount of praise, though I fear it may go to your head.

yes.0: Hm, now where did I put it? Please, talk to me again in a moment.

no.0: Don't be ungrateful. If you don't accept it by #rJanuary 31, 2011#k, I'll simply toss it away.

1.0: Here, this rare Recipe is from my private collection. It's probably wasted on you, but it's beneath me anyway, and I see no merit in letting it go to waste. To think, a Lv. 4 Blacksmith. Next thing you know, you'll come up to me claiming to be a Lv. #r10#k Blacksmith...
